facts.value: Students enrolled in programs from other departments can take certain modules from the Department of Economics, known as export modules of the Department of Economics, including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: A list has been compiled for the programs of other departments indicating which export modules students can register for in the Department of Economics and how they can integrate these export modules into their program in their home department.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Furthermore, students cannot transfer other modules from the Department of Economics into their program in another department, nor can they earn credit points (CP) from the Department of Economics that deviate from those required in their own department.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
